title: LOVE
text: LOVE. These are SO handy.  Easy to clean and use because they are silicone.  I am not always a fan of silicone but these funnels are terrific.  I bag and freeze lots of stuff.  It's nice that there are three different sizes.  The two large funnels have about the same size spout, but one could be better used for dry stuff cause of it's smaller cup.  And then the smallest size has a wider mouth.  I would recommend this set if you ever use a funnel!  Did I mention they are dishwasher safe?? Oh yeah!  They store easily inside each other as well.

product_metadata.title: Farm to Table 5888 Canning Funnel Set, Silicone, 3-Piece
features: PUT THE "CAN" IN CANNING: Stop spilling powders, liquids, and other ingredients while transferring in your canning process! This 3-piece funnel set allows you to neatly pour ingredients.
DURABLE DESIGN: This set is made from food-safe silicone, meaning it's flexible yet long-lasting.
THREE UNIQUE SIZES: This set comes with 3 distinct funnels, so they are sure to stay in place while you use them.
EASY TO CLEAN: These bright pink funnels are dishwasher safe. As easy to clean as they are to use!
MEASUREMENTS: Top diameters: 2.5", 3.5" and 4.5", Stems: 1", 1/2", and 3/8" wide.
description: Take the mess out of pouring ingredients into bottles and containers. Farm Table's Set of 3 Silicone Funnels boast a delightful pink color, perfect for transferring those berry preserves. Made of flexible, yet sturdy silicone, the funnels will stay in place when in use and are heat-resistant up to 445°F. Included are 2.5", 3.5" and 4.5" funnels, with stems measuring 1", 1/2", and 3/8" wide, all great sizes for transferring liquids and powders into storage jars or stylish serving bottles. The range of sizes allow you to easily pour into both small and larger jars and bottles. Ideal for cooking and baking ingredients, home canning, transferring salad dressings, garnishing plates and meals, dispensing melted chocolate over desserts, and even refilling essential oils, perfumes, and more. Get a more controlled, consistent and clean flow of liquids and ingredients.
